render_policy: Render MST as active for LittleData. The matrix is a retro-map of the historical manual-upload window (2026-05-03 → 2026-06-26): real ads placed into ICP × tone cells after the fact — it was not designed as an MST. Show performance only where a real ad backs the cell; empty cells mean no historical creative existed there. No Pass/Conditional/Fail calls — the account is pre-signal (2 purchases, mixed attribution) and every read is validation_required. The first designed matrix ships with brief LD-B001.

plain_text.headline: This one's different.
plain_text.primary: This one's different. We turn any American street into a stunning framed print — the block they grew up on, where life-changing moments happened. Watch their face light up with this unique piece of personalized wall decor.
plain_text.concept: Emotional Gift Moment. Single print staged in a warm domestic scene, narrative headline about the recipient's reaction.
plain_text.visual: Warm lifestyle photography (LD-DS-WARM-LIFESTYLE), precisely-named street in the artwork.
plain_text.hypothesis: Retro-mapped historical ad — produced 1 of the account's 2 purchases (male 25-34, 2026-06-21) on $107.24 spend. Best purchase-per-dollar signal in the window.
plain_text.learning_question: Does the recipient-reaction gift narrative hold when hook and staging are isolated in a designed MST (brief LD-B001)?
plain_text.placement: Unknown — placement metrics unavailable in this window

plain_text.headline: 100 dads already have one. Does yours?
plain_text.primary: Give a meaningful gift to dad — the city that made him who he is. The street, the neighborhood, it's all part of his story.
plain_text.concept: Dad FOMO Social Proof. Stat-question hook plus review trust bar, Father's Day occasion.
plain_text.visual: Editorial white design system (LD-DS-EDITORIAL-WHITE), two prints.
plain_text.hypothesis: Retro-mapped historical ad — $11.62 / 387 impressions / 0 purchases: below any read threshold.
plain_text.learning_question: Does social-momentum framing move gift buyers when funded past a real sample threshold?

plain_text.primary: "I Love This! My husband and I have this hanging in our kitchen — it's the city of our first trip together. Looking at it every morning never gets old." Read why our customers keep ordering more.

plain_text.headline: No gamble here!
plain_text.primary: No gamble here! Every print is shipped on high-quality, heavyweight fine art paper with archival inks, framed in real wood. Free shipping, guaranteed.
plain_text.concept: Quality Objection Rebuttal. Macro product close-up plus 'not a poster' spec proof and guarantee, retargeting.

plain_text.learning_question: Is the retargeting pool behind this cell large enough to produce a statistical read at current budget?
